screens.prompt:
Create an authentic, pixel-perfect WhatsApp Business mobile interface (393px width, mobile iOS/Android WhatsApp standard styling) for Novotel Concierge.

Header / Navigation:
- WhatsApp Business top bar with back chevron (<), official Novotel crest avatar (navy circular crest with gold 'N'), contact info: "Novotel Concierge" followed by official WhatsApp green checkmark verified badge (verified icon in solid green circle with white check), subline: "Official Business Account".
- Header trailing action icons: video call icon, phone call icon, and more options (3 vertical dots).

Chat Background:
- Authentic WhatsApp subtle chat doodle wallpaper pattern (light warm parchment/slate tinted background #EFEAE2 with subtle watermark icons).

Chat Stream Content:
1. Encryption Security Notice Pill:
   - Centered small amber/gold lock icon pill: "Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted. No one outside of this chat, not even WhatsApp, can read or listen to them. Tap to learn more."
2. Date separator: "TODAY" in subtle grey rounded pill.

3. Message 1: Rich Pre-Arrival Welcome Card (Inbound from Novotel Concierge)
   - Left-aligned WhatsApp incoming message bubble (clean crisp white card with slight rounded corners and bubble tail, subtle drop shadow).
   - Rich Link Preview Header: Editorial photo {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_11}} (Novotel heated pool deck at dusk) in 16:9 ratio with rounded top corners.
   - Domain / Category subhead inside preview: "novotel.accor.com/concierge · EXECUTIVE ACCESS"
   - Headline / Title: "Welcome to Novotel, Mr. Hastings" (in bold serif/display font).
   - Body copy: "Your Executive Suite 412 is being prepared. Customize your bedding, warm towel timings, and tennis court access ahead of arrival."
   - Timestamp and delivery metadata: "14:15" with double grey/blue checkmarks.
   - Interactive WhatsApp Quick-Reply / CTA Button stack directly attached beneath the bubble:
     * Button 1: "✨ Personalize My Stay" (with small external mini-app launch icon, styled in crisp WhatsApp blue/teal interactive button bar with border separation).
     * Button 2: "📞 Call Concierge" (with phone icon).

4. Outbound Guest Reply (Simulating real interaction):
   - Right-aligned outgoing WhatsApp green bubble (#E7FFDB or #DCF8C6) with tail.
   - Content: "Thank you! I just requested the memory foam pillow, heated bath towels at 20:30, and ambient AC set to 20°C via the link."
   - Timestamp "14:18" with double blue read ticks (✓✓).

5. Message 2: Live Action Confirmation Card (Inbound from Novotel Concierge)
   - Left-aligned incoming WhatsApp message bubble.
   - Header tag: "NOVOTEL CONCIERGE DISPATCH" in gold/navy micro-caps.
   - Body copy:
     "✓ Butler Service Confirmed: Your heated bath towels are scheduled for delivery to Suite 412 at 20:30. Room temperature set to 20°C."
   - Key attributes highlight badge list or pill:
     * "Suite: 412 Presidential"
     * "Turndown: 20:30"
     * "Attendant: Elena S. (Duty Floor 4)"
   - Timestamp: "14:19".
   - Attached Action Button:
     * Button: "⚡ Track Request in Mini-App" (with arrow icon).

Bottom WhatsApp Chat Input Bar:
- Bottom docked bar with: emoji smile icon, plus icon (+ for attachment), text input field with placeholder "Message", camera icon, and circular green voice microphone button.

Typography and Brand:
- Authentic WhatsApp layout structure combined with refined Novotel typography (cinematic headlines, clean functional sans-serif body, navy and warm champagne gold accents where appropriate). Crisp status bar at the top (time 14:20, signal, WiFi, battery).

outputComponents.text:
I have designed the WhatsApp Business conversational UI and rich preview cards for the **Novotel Concierge** integration (Mobile 393×852).

### What Was Designed:

1. **WhatsApp Business Header & Verification:**
   - Official Novotel crest avatar with deep brand navy `#171E52` and gold monogram.
   - **"Novotel Concierge"** header with the official green verified badge (✓) and *"Official Business Account"* subline.
   - Native audio call, video call, and options actions.

2. **Message 1: Pre-Arrival Welcome Card (Rich Link Preview):**
   - Inbound WhatsApp bubble with tail and signature doodle wallpaper backdrop.
   - **Header Photo:** Editorial twilight photography of the heated rooftop infinity pool deck with underwater glow and sun loungers (`Editorial luxury photography of a high-end luxury hotel rooftop heated infinity pool deck at dusk or twilight, warm ambient glowing underwater lights, sun loungers with rolled plush navy towels, elegant modern architecture, tranquil city skyline view in evening golden blue hour, cinematic, 8k resolution, Architectural Digest style.`).
   - **Metadata Badge:** `novotel.accor.com/concierge · EXECUTIVE ACCESS`.
   - **Headline & Body:** *"Welcome to Novotel, Mr. Hastings"* detailing Suite 412 preparations (bedding preferences, warm towels, tennis court reservations).
   - **Interactive WhatsApp CTA Buttons:**
     - `✨ Personalize My Stay` (direct Mini-App launch button).
     - `📞 Call Concierge`.

3. **Guest Confirmation & Real-time Conversational Flow:**
   - Outbound guest reply bubble in WhatsApp green with double blue ticks (`✓✓`).

4. **Message 2: Live Action Confirmation Card:**
   - Official *"Novotel Concierge Dispatch · Confirmed"* header with live pulse dot.
   - **Body:** *"✓ Butler Service Confirmed: Your heated bath towels are scheduled for delivery to Suite 412 at 20:30. Room temperature set to 20°C."*
   - **Key Attribute Badges:** Suite 412, Turndown at 20:30, and assigned butler Elena S.
   - **Interactive Button:** `⚡ Track Request in Mini-App` with directional arrow.

5. **WhatsApp Native Chat Chrome:**
   - End-to-end encryption security banner, date divider, and bottom input field with attachments, camera, and voice microphone.
